people.imagined: A dusty road camp at dusk. He sits by a dead fire chewing the cold pipe, riding behind someone he has followed for twenty years. He has just refused a hire; the pipe has not moved.
people.subject: The moment: seated on a saddle blanket at a road camp at dusk, he looks up slowly at the viewer, jaw working on a cold pipe. Face: most important, the pipe and the dust: an unlit brown wooden pipe with a chewed bone stem clamped in his teeth at the right corner, and pale road dust packed into every crease of his face so the lines show as pale grooves. A long, hard, weathered face; deep-set grey-brown eyes narrowed; short grey-flecked black brows; a hooked nose; a short stubble; thin lips around the stem. Hair: black with grey at the temples, bound in a high knot under a plain silver crown, a strip of grey silk tied round the forehead. Body: lean, broad-shouldered, hunched forward with forearms on his knees. Clothing: long robes of fine grey silk in two crossed collars edged in charcoal, a silver-grey gauze over-robe lifting in the wind, the left sleeve long and flowing past the hand and resting over his knee, a narrow sash with a small silver sword-token; the silk pale with road dust at the shoulders. Hands and objects: his right hand rests on the hilt of a plain straight sword laid across his lap. Power: a faint thread of grey-gold metal qi curls from the sword, with one warm red mote beside it. Background: a dry plain under a violet dusk, a low red sun and a thread of smoke from a cold fire. Light: soft spirit-light from the sword edge, a pale rim of low sunset on his shoulder and crown. Expression: a still, unhurried look from under lowered brows, the jaw set round the stem, a man who has just refused a hire and will not say why.

people.imagined: The contract house's counting table. She counts the sleeve prices and brings out her smile only to count; the abacus at her belt clicks. She was bought out of a camel debt at fourteen.
people.subject: The moment: at a counting table she smiles brightly while pressing the beads of a small iron abacus, the smile fading as she looks up. Face: most important, the smile: a bright, wide, practised smile showing teeth, placed on a face that is otherwise flat and cold, with the eyes not joining in. A small, round, sallow face; narrow, black, calculating eyes; thin arched brows; a small straight nose; a mole at the corner of her mouth; fine lines bracket her mouth. Hair: black, severely parted in the middle and wound in a flat knot at the crown, held by a plain silver crown-comb and a grey silk cord. Body: small, upright, hands busy. Clothing: long robes of fine silver-grey silk in two crossed collars edged in charcoal, a pale grey gauze over-robe, the left sleeve long but neatly folded back at the wrist and pinned for work, a narrow sash with a small silver sword-token. Hands and objects: a small iron abacus with dark polished beads under her thumb, hung at her belt on a chain; a stack of flat copper coins in neat columns on the table; a small silk purse. Power: a few grey-gold motes of metal qi drift over the beads as they click. Background: a quiet pale office with a paper screen and a window of misty desert light. Light: cool pearly mist-light from the upper left, a soft silver rim along her cheek. Expression: a bright practised smile laid over a flat cold face, a cautious woman who smiles only to count.

people.imagined: The valley hall door at night. He holds the lamp while the head opens the founder's robe for another; every time the wind rattles the door he stares at the ceiling, jaw tight.
people.subject: The moment: in a dim doorway he holds up a small lamp, his eyes rolled up to the ceiling as the wind rattles the door. Face: most important, the soot thumbprint and the upward stare: a dark soot thumbprint smudged on the left sleeve at the front of the frame, and eyes fixed on the rafters with the whites showing. A square, plain, young face; thick dark brows drawn down; a heavy jaw clenched; narrow dark eyes; a short nose; a mouth set hard with resentment. A line of sweat shines at the hairline and a nick runs through one eyebrow. Hair: black, cropped short and bristly, bound in a small knot with a plain silver pin and a grey silk band. Body: stocky, broad, planted. Clothing: the simplest graceful grey silk of an outer disciple: a crossed-collar robe with charcoal edging, a short flowing gauze over-sleeve on the right and the left sleeve long past the hand, soot-marked at the cuff, a narrow sash with a small silver sword-token. Hands and objects: an oil lamp with a small upright flame in his right hand, a pale pick-scar on the left hand. Slung across the back, past the right shoulder rises the hilt of a plain straight double-edged sword of excellent make, its grip wrapped in grey cord, a plain grey iron guard, a dun scabbard stitched fine, and a small tin lamp-hook on the strap. Background: a dark wooden door shaking on its hinges, a bar of cold moonlit mist under it. Light: warm lamplight from the right, silver moonlight from the doorway. Expression: a clenched, resentful, loyal glare at the rafters, the whites of the eyes showing.

people.imagined: A hot steppe road after her first sealed contract. She wants the next long hire, whatever the contract house says. Dust red on her boots; two tight braids; she faces the sun squarely.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a hot red-dust road, hands on hips, chin up, she looks the viewer straight in the eye. Face: most important, the two braids and the red dust: two tight braids standing out from her head on each side, and a stripe of red dust across her boots and shins at the lower edge of the frame. A narrow, tanned, bright face; slightly flared nostrils; keen, dark, hot eyes; thick straight brows; a wide mouth in a tight proud smile. Sweat shines at her temples and a fine layer of red dust powders her cheeks. Hair: black, in two tight braids to her shoulders tied with grey silk cord, a small silver pin at the crown. Body: lithe, strong shoulders, upright. Clothing: the simplest graceful grey silk of an outer disciple: a fitted crossed-collar robe with charcoal edging, the left sleeve long and flowing past the hand, a thin gauze scarf of silver-grey at her neck stirring in the wind, a narrow sash with a small silver sword-token, red dust on the hem. Hands and objects: a plain sword in its scabbard at her left hip, her right hand on her hip. Power: a few warm red motes of fire qi float up from her shoulders in the heat. Background: a flat red steppe under a bright pale sky, heat haze shimmering, a single dry thorn tree at the roadside and a pale cloud mark on the far edge of the sky. Light: bright spirit-light of noon with a pearly rim on her braids and cheek. Expression: a proud, impatient, brave half-smile, the hot dark eyes steady on the viewer.

people.imagined: The pass in autumn with a mule load of ore, more than anyone asked for, because a polisher at the forge will take it. He waits for a joke to be explained a second time.
people.subject: The moment: standing by a laden mule on a mountain track at dawn, he is mid-grin, one hand pulling a rag from his pocket as if to polish something. Face: most important, the hands and the rag: both fists ground black with ore dust in every knuckle crease, and a white polishing rag, not his own, half pulled from his pocket. A broad, open, honest face with a round chin; wide-set kind brown eyes; thick, slightly crooked brows; a snub nose; a big, uncertain grin. Hair: black, in a short untidy tail bound with a plain silver ring. Body: stocky and strong, a little clumsy; he stands with his big hands hanging, shoulders rounded from carrying, one foot turned slightly in. Clothing: graceful grey silk of an inner disciple: a crossed-collar robe with charcoal edging, a silver-grey gauze over-robe, the left sleeve long but rolled back for work, ore-dust at the hem, a narrow sash with a small silver sword-token, a leather strap of the mule load across his chest. Hands and objects: ore-black hands, the white rag, a canvas sack of dull grey ore on his back; the mule wears two heavy panniers tied with red cord. Slung across the back, past the right shoulder rises the hilt of a plain narrow straight sword of excellent make, its grip wrapped in coarse grey cloth, a plain oval guard polished to a mirror shine, a scabbard of grey lacquer, and a strip of polisher's rag knotted at the pommel. Power: a few grey-gold motes of metal qi sparkle in the ore dust on his knuckles. Background: a stony autumn pass, orange birches and mist rising from the valley. Light: soft golden dawn-light with a silver rim on his shoulder. Expression: trusting, hopeful, a bit puzzled.

people.imagined: The contract house's desk. She presses the Seal on what she is handed and asks nothing; not a hair out of place, a brass stud on a cord, waiting for someone else's desk.
people.subject: The moment: at a desk she presses a hand-sized bronze seal onto a paper with an even, steady arm, looking up under her brows at the viewer. Face: most important, the brass stud on its cord: a bright brass stud the size of a coin hung on a cord round her neck, shining, and her hair absolutely perfect. A sleek, oval, pale face; cold, dark, almond eyes; thin, perfectly arched brows; a small, thin nose; thin, red-painted lips in a narrow smile; cheeks powdered to a flawless pallor. Hair: jet black, glossy, in a perfect high knot with every strand smoothed, held by a plain silver crown and a grey jade pin. Body: slim, very upright, sleeves immaculate. Clothing: long robes of fine silver-grey silk in two crossed collars edged in charcoal, a pale gauze over-robe falling in smooth folds, the long left sleeve folded and pinned at the elbow with a small grey button, a narrow sash of grey silk with a small silver sword-token. Hands and objects: the bronze seal, marked only with a plain sleeve-and-sword emblem, pressed down on a blank sheet; a pot of red paste open beside it and a small dab on her fingertip. Power: a thin ribbon of grey-gold metal qi runs along the seal's edge. Background: a bare desk, a pale screen and a window of misty desert light. Light: cool moonlike light from the upper left with a silver rim on her cheek and the brass stud. Expression: a cold, watchful, narrow-eyed composure, the red lips just curved, an ambitious woman who stamps what she is handed and asks nothing.

people.imagined: The hall of sleeves at first light. She sweeps with a broom worn to a stump, and her eyes go to every visitor's sleeve. The newest sleeve on the beam is her brother's.
people.subject: The moment: in a high hall hung with rows of grey sleeves she stops sweeping and stares at the viewer's sleeve. Face: most important, the stump broom: a straw broom worn down to a short stub, gripped in both hands at her chest, and the rows of limp grey sleeves hanging on beams behind her. A thin, solemn, pale face; large, dark, searching eyes; thin straight brows; a small nose; a small, tight, grieving mouth, the eyes wet. Hair: black, in a long single braid pinned up under a plain silver comb and a grey silk ribbon. Body: slight, narrow, upright, thin shoulders pulled up and back stiff, as if at attention. Clothing: the simplest graceful grey silk of an outer disciple: a clean crossed-collar robe with charcoal edging, the left sleeve long but tied back for sweeping, a narrow sash with a small silver sword-token. Hands and objects: the stub broom held upright, its straw bound tight with red thread; the nearest sleeve on the beam is pale grey with a single dark stain at the cuff. Past the right shoulder rises the rust-red-corded hilt of a plain slim jian with a round guard slung on her back, its red-brown scabbard held by a plain strap, the steel darkened to a warm tint. Power: one faint grey mote of metal qi hangs by the hilt. Background: dim wooden beams hung with dozens of faded grey sleeves in rows, mist drifting between them. Light: a pale silver moonbeam from a high window at the upper left, dust turning in it like slow gold specks. Expression: a still, patient stare fixed on the sleeve, the young face grieving, the lips held together.

people.imagined: The keeper of contracts reading a client's hands before the client's letter. Ink on two fingers; she turns the hand palm up and says the price.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a desk she holds out her own ink-stained hand and looks at the viewer's hands as if reading them, a pleasant smile on her face. Face: most important, the ink on two fingers: the forefinger and middle finger of her right hand stained black to the second knuckle, held up in the foreground. A neat, handsome, oval face; warm, sharp, dark brown eyes; a high smooth forehead; arched brows; a straight nose; a pleasant, wide, controlled smile; light lines at the corners of the eyes. Hair: black with a streak of grey at the left temple, wound in a neat high knot under a silver crown with a long silver pin. Body: slim, upright, easy. Clothing: the elder's richer robes of silver-grey brocade woven with a faint sword-and-sleeve pattern, in three crossed collars edged in charcoal, a pale gauze over-robe with wide sleeves, the left sleeve long and folded back at the wrist, a narrow sash with a silver sword-token, a small bronze seal on a cord at her neck. Hands and objects: the ink-stained hand; on the desk a bound book and a plain sword with a wire-wrapped hilt. Power: a calm pale grey-gold glow of metal qi gathers round her shoulders with a warm earth-yellow thread in it. Background: a bright, tidy contract hall with a paper screen and drifting mist at its window. Light: warm pearl-gold spirit-light from the upper left, a soft silver rim on her hair. Expression: ambitious, genial, shrewd.

people.imagined: Home after twenty years of caravans. Road-burnt dark, a scar that makes her mouth smile where she does not mean to. She looks at the valley as at a place she has paid for.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a doorway, home from the road, she looks at the viewer with a stare that does not match her mouth. Face: most important, the scar smile: a pale scar runs from the left corner of her mouth up toward the cheekbone, pulling that corner into a permanent crooked half-smile while her eyes stay hard and flat. A long, square-jawed face burnt dark brown by the sun; narrow, grey, unsmiling eyes; straight heavy brows; a strong nose; a wide mouth. Dust lies in the lines at her eyes and the scar shines slightly. Hair: black, cut to the jaw and wind-roughed, bound with a strip of faded red silk under a plain silver crown. Body: tall, rangy, broad-shouldered, standing wide. Clothing: long robes of fine grey silk in two crossed collars edged in charcoal, a silver-grey gauze over-robe trail-stained at the hem but clean at the cuff, the long left sleeve flowing, a dark silk scarf at the neck, a narrow sash with a small silver sword-token and a plain sword. Hands and objects: her right hand resting on the sword's hilt, scarred across the broad brown knuckles with a pale seam across one. Power: a strong warm red haze of fire qi lifts like heat from her shoulders and the sword, with grey-gold sparks in it. Background: the doorway of a grey stone hall with a hot dusty courtyard beyond and a violet haze. Light: hard bright noon spirit-light from the upper left, deep shadow beneath her brow and a silver rim on the scar. Expression: a hard, honest, wrathful stare that does not match the crooked smile, a woman looking at the valley as at a place she has paid for.

people.imagined: The mouth of the Can Tương mine. A square slow man leans on his sword as on a walking stick and points with it at the vein. He trusts the smiths and he trusts the ring of their blades.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a mine mouth he uses the point of a plain sword to indicate a vein of grey ore in the wall, looking at the viewer to be sure they follow. Face: most important, the sword as pointer: a plain straight sword held pointing, its point resting on a streak of bright grey ore, the hilt wrapped in grey cord. A square, solid, slow face with a heavy brow; calm, small, brown eyes; thick brown brows; a wide, flat nose; a patient mouth; a grey-black short beard with grey dust settled in it and in the lines of his brow. Hair: grey-black, short and bristly, bound under a plain silver crown and a grey silk band. Body: square, thick, broad, immovable. Clothing: robes of silver-grey silk in two crossed collars edged in charcoal, a grey gauze over-robe, the long left sleeve tied back with a strip of dark silk and ore-dust at the cuffs, a narrow sash with a small silver sword-token, a short lamp of brass at the belt. Hands and objects: the sword, its blade bright and dark-edged; a lump of grey ore with silver glints in the left hand. Power: a slow grey-gold shimmer of metal qi gathers in the ore and along the blade. Background: the dark mouth of a mine with timber props and a rail, pale mist breathing out of it. Light: warm lamp-gold from the right, cool silver spirit-light from the upper left, a glint on the vein. Expression: a patient, stubborn, loyal steadiness with calm eyes, a slow man making sure you follow.

people.imagined: The outer gate's yard. Chalk to his elbows, he draws a footwork pattern on the flagstones and speaks without raising his voice. He has never been hired out.
people.subject: The moment: in a yard he kneels beside a flagstone drawing a footwork pattern in chalk, looking up at the viewer. Face: most important, the chalk: white chalk dust coating both forearms to the elbows and the sleeves of his robe, and a stick of chalk in his fingers. A long, gentle, deeply lined face; steady pale-brown eyes; long white-streaked brows; a long straight nose; a calm, closed mouth; a grey moustache and small beard. Hair: grey, in a neat topknot held by a plain silver crown. Body: tall, thin, slightly stooped, patient, kneeling on one knee with his long back bent and head lowered a little. Clothing: robes of silver-grey silk in two crossed collars edged in charcoal, a pale gauze over-robe, the long left sleeve tucked into the sash, the silk chalk-dusted at knees and forearms, a narrow sash with a small silver sword-token. Hands and objects: the chalk in his right hand, the left on his knee; the chalk pattern a row of footprints joined by arrows round a circle, powder lying in a white fan on the stones. A long straight sword of excellent make, its grip wrapped in thin grey silk, a long-quilloned guard of pale steel, a scabbard of undyed ash-wood faintly chalk-white at the throat, is slung diagonally across his back, its hilt above the right shoulder. Power: a calm grey-gold breath of metal qi rises from the circle like frost. Background: a flagstone yard with chalk lines, a low wall, a row of young disciples in grey blurred behind in soft mist. Light: soft silver morning mist-light from the upper left showing the grain of chalk on his sleeves. Expression: a level, unhurried look up from the chalk, the brow smooth and the mouth quiet, a man who has never needed to be hired out.

people.imagined: The hall of the founder's robe, after the fold. The head has opened it for him with his own Wind and the boy's nose bleeds. He turns his head toward every draught.
people.subject: The moment: in a dim hall a boy stands with his head turned sharply toward a draught, a line of red under his nose. Face: most important, the red crust: a thick line of dried and fresh rust-red crust under the left nostril, smeared to the lip, clearly visible. A thin, quick, boyish face; wide, bright, pale-brown eyes with a faint silvery shine; thin brows; a narrow nose; a half-open mouth; hollow cheeks. Hair: dark brown-black, messy, standing on end as if from wind, a small silver pin lifting out of it. Body: slight, quick, shoulders high, narrow, arms thin, the fingers of the open hand slightly spread. Clothing: graceful grey silk of an inner disciple: a crossed-collar robe with charcoal edging, a pale gauze over-robe lifting sideways, the left sleeve long and flowing, a narrow sash with a small silver sword-token. Hands and objects: one hand held open at his side, palm up, as if feeling the air. Slung across the back, past the left shoulder rises the hilt of a plain short slim sword of excellent make, its grip wrapped in grey silk cord with loose ends, a small slim steel guard, a scabbard of thin pale ash, and a short grey silk streamer on the pommel that always stirs. Power: a thread of dust lifts in a slow spiral by his palm and faint pale-silver wind qi ripples through his hair and sleeves, all in one direction. Background: a dim hall with a hung grey robe in shadow and a pale draught of mist. Light: cool silver spirit-light from the upper left, a bright thin gleam along his cheek. Expression: a quick, bright, sidelong look, the lips parted and the eyes darting after the draught, with a boy's stubborn courage in the set of the chin.

people.imagined: Her room, a half-packed kit under the bed. She has asked for the Desert Road every month and put her own name on the list behind her master's back. She holds a scabbard that has never been scuffed.
people.subject: The moment: sitting on a bunk edge she holds a scabbard across her knees, polishing it with a thumb, looking up in challenge at the viewer. Face: most important, the unscuffed scabbard: a black lacquered scabbard perfectly smooth, bright and unmarked, with a thin brass band at the mouth and one at the tip, in the foreground, and a half-packed kit visible at the frame edge. A sharp, handsome, tanned face; hard, bright, hazel eyes; straight, thick brows; a straight nose; a thin set mouth. Hair: black, in a high tight tail with a grey silk cord and a small silver crown. Body: lean, trim, restless, sitting upright on the very edge of the bunk with her knees apart, ready to stand. Clothing: graceful robes of fine grey silk in two crossed collars edged in charcoal, a silver-grey gauze over-robe, the left sleeve long and folded back, a narrow sash with a small silver sword-token. Hands and objects: the black scabbard, its lacquer shining like a black mirror with a long white reflection; below the bunk an open bag with a coiled rope, three flat cakes in cloth and a clay water flask. Power: a few warm red-orange and grey-gold motes of fire and metal qi drift upward past the scabbard. Background: a plain bunk room with a window of bright misty light. Light: bright pearl spirit-light from the window at the upper left, a silver rim on her jaw. Expression: a hard, restless, challenging stare, the thin mouth tight and the chin lifted, eager to stand and go.

people.imagined: The copying desk. Ink in the grain of her nails; a cloth for every blot. She has written a camel train that nobody's seen into the road book and watches the viewer to see if they will check.
people.subject: The moment: at a copying desk she wipes a blot with a cloth, eyes lifting warily. Face: most important, the nails: all ten fingernails and the skin around them stained black with ink, held in the foreground, with a white cloth in the right hand. A neat, small, pale face; large dark watchful eyes; thin brows; a small straight nose; a small mouth tight with caution. Hair: black, in a smooth bun with two plain silver pins and a grey ribbon. Body: slight, careful, narrow shoulders; she sits close to the desk with shoulders hunched and elbows tucked in, ready to hide her page. Clothing: the simplest graceful grey silk of an outer disciple: a clean crossed-collar robe with charcoal edging, the left sleeve long but tied up with a cord for writing, a narrow sash with a small silver sword-token. Hands and objects: a brush thin as a reed with a worn tip in the left hand, the folded cloth in the right, a bound book open and blank; beside it a lamp with a green glass shade burning low. Past the left shoulder rises the rust-red-corded hilt of a plain straight double-edged sword slung on her back, its red-brown scabbard held by a plain strap, the steel darkened to a warm tint. Power: a faint grey-gold mote of metal qi rests on the brush tip. Background: a small desk with rolls of paper and a window of misty desert light. Light: soft silver light from the window at the upper left with a warm lamp glow on the page and every ink-black line in her nails. Expression: a wary, upward flick of the eyes with the mouth held neat, hungry and guarded as she watches whether the viewer will check.

people.imagined: The pasture road. Two rough-coated dogs at his heels, he understands the saying on the lintel better than the rest. He is sunburnt to the neck and says nothing.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a pasture at dawn with two dogs sitting at his heels, he looks gently at the viewer. Face: most important, the dogs: two rough-coated tan-and-grey shepherd dogs, one on each side of his knees, panting, heads up, ears pricked, big in the frame. A long, calm, sunburnt face, red to the collar and pale above the hat line; patient pale-blue eyes; faint light brows; a long nose; a quiet mouth. Hair: sandy-brown, short, tied back with a grey silk band and a plain silver pin. Body: lean, lanky, relaxed, feet apart and shoulders loose, his long neck sunburnt red. Clothing: the simplest graceful grey silk of an outer disciple: a plain crossed-collar robe with charcoal edging, the left sleeve long and tied back, a narrow sash with a small silver sword-token, a staff-strap across the chest. Hands and objects: a crook-headed wooden staff in his right hand, the left dropped to a dog's head; the left dog has a grey muzzle and a white blaze on the chest, the right one a brown patch over one eye; a leather leash lies coiled and unused over his shoulder. A plain long straight sword of excellent make, its grip wrapped in braided dun hide thong, a plain bar guard, a scabbard of dun sheepskin with the wool left on, and a carved bone toggle from a dog's knucklebone, is slung diagonally across his back, its hilt above the left shoulder. Power: a few soft earth-yellow motes of earth qi drift in the grass at his feet. Background: wide dry grassland under a pale pearly sky, small distant sheep, a low mist. Light: bright clear dawn-light from the upper left making the dust on the dogs' coats shine like gold. Expression: a gentle, quiet gaze, the mouth silent and the eyes patient.

people.imagined: A mine gallery in the dark. His lamp is the one that goes out. A cough, a scar on the forehead where the lamp hit him, and he is not unhappy.
people.subject: The moment: in a dark mine gallery he holds a dead lamp up and peers at it, coughing into his fist. Face: most important, the scar: a raised, shiny, round lamp-scar the size of a coin in the middle of the forehead, pink against the grey-dusted skin, and the cough. A young, round, dusty face; pale eyes; thin light brows; a snub nose; a loose, content mouth. Hair: brown, matted with grey dust, short, a plain silver pin through a small knot. Body: slouched, broad, a little round, his back against a timber prop, shoulders sagging. Clothing: the simplest graceful grey silk of an outer disciple, dust-grey: a crossed-collar robe with charcoal edging, short flowing sleeves, a narrow sash with a small silver sword-token. Hands and objects: a small miner's oil lamp with no flame, its glass cracked and the wick dried, in his left hand; his right fist at his mouth with a thin line of grey dust on each knuckle. A plain short slim sword of excellent make, its grip wrapped in dark cloth blackened by lamp smoke, a small plain disc guard, a scabbard of grey-black wood, and a punched tin tally disc on a cord, is slung diagonally across his back, its hilt above the left shoulder. Power: a single earth-brown mote of earth qi glimmers near the dead lamp. Background: a black gallery with timber props, a faint pale spirit-light far behind and a trace of mist. Light: only a pale silver glow from the upper left, deep dark around, one thin beam finding the round scar like a coin. Expression: a sooty, easy half-smile with trusting eyes and a lazy cough, not unhappy to peer at the dead lamp.

people.imagined: 560, settling in the grassland valley under the Pivot. A memorial portrait of the lean wandering swordsman with a hawk's pinion in his hair, never seen to hurry, who cut a saying on a lintel.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened; a lean swordsman stands in grass wind, calm. Face: most important, the pinion: a long brown hawk's feather tucked through his topknot, rising at an angle behind his head, big and clear. A long, lean, calm, wind-weathered face; narrow, steady, dark eyes; thin dark brows; a straight nose; a thin, closed, patient mouth; a short grey-black beard. Hair: black, in a topknot held by a silver pin and the feather. Body: lean, tall, relaxed, one hip cocked, shoulders narrow, arms long and loose, his weight on one leg, quite unhurried. Clothing: the founder's flowing robes of pale grey silk in three crossed collars edged in charcoal, a silver-grey gauze over-robe streaming sideways in the wind, the single long left sleeve hanging past the hand, a narrow sash with a small silver sword-token, a faint embroidered border of sword and sleeve in silver thread. Hands and objects: a plain sword in its scabbard in the right hand, point down; the pinion in his hair brown with a pale bar near the tip. Power: pale-silver wisps of wind qi curl round his sleeve and through the grass, softened by the fade. Background: a pale, mottled, aged-silk ground with faint grass and a low mountain in mist. Light: soft pearl spirit-light from the upper left, dark vignette, the grass at his feet moving in a slow wave. Expression: calm, unhurried, aloof.

people.imagined: The second head, 790-1090. A memorial portrait of the short brisk woman who had no Wind and built the valley a living: the seal cord round her neck and a ledger under her arm.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened; a short brisk woman stands with a ledger under her arm. Face: most important, the seal cord and the ledger: a thick cord round her neck carrying a bronze seal on her chest, and a thick book bound in cord clamped under her left arm. A round, compact, shrewd face; bright small eyes; neat straight brows; a short nose; a firm, brisk, small mouth; a double line between the brows and a few fine lines at the outer corners of her eyes. Hair: black with grey, in a tight high knot with a plain silver crown and pin. Body: short, sturdy, upright, quick. Clothing: the head's richest robes of silver-grey brocade in three crossed collars edged in charcoal, a pale gauze over-robe, the long left sleeve tied back with a cord for work, a narrow sash with a small silver sword-token and a small iron abacus hung on a chain, a faint silver embroidered border of sword and sleeve. Hands and objects: the right hand on the seal; the left arm pressing the book. Power: a soft grey-gold glow of metal qi lies round the seal, softened by the fade. Background: a pale, mottled, aged-silk ground with faint rows of grey sleeves on a beam in mist. Light: soft spirit-light from the upper left, dark vignette; the faded silk turns the grey a pale warm putty and leaves a gold glint only on the seal. Expression: a brisk, patient, pragmatic firmness, the small mouth set and the eyes quick, a woman who built the valley a living.
